candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vestník verejného obstarávania (Slovak Public Procurement Bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated publication venue for all above-threshold Slovak public tenders. Notices for ATM servicing, cash processing, payment terminals and card acceptance for public bodies (ministries, Sociálna poisťovňa, state banks, hospitals, transport operators) appear here with CPV codes and estimated values, which act as a hard quantitative proxy for fleet sizes and transaction volumes.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for browsing
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector information, mandatory disclosure under Act 343/2015 Z. z.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scraping of the notice search UI filtered by CPV (30123400, 30233190, 66110000, 79710000, 50000000-family) plus keyword filters; prefer the open-data XML dumps where available.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ÚVO site structure
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania platobné terminály bankomaty

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (tender search)
candidates.why_relevant: The operational query interface over the Vestník; allows CPV/keyword/contracting-authority filtering, which is the practical entry point for building a longitudinal series of SK public payment/ATM/cash procurements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised HTTP queries against the search endpoint; paginate and store notice detail pages.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania platobné terminály bankomaty

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie profilov / profil verejného obstarávateľa
candidates.why_relevant: Every contracting authority (incl. NBS, Slovenská pošta, state banks, Sociálna poisťovňa) has a legally mandated profile aggregating its notices, contracts and award documents. It is the fastest way to enumerate the actor map of public buyers of payment/cash infrastructure and then snowball into their documents.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate profiles of a curated buyer list, then crawl each profile's document tab.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa zmluvy

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Register of Contracts
candidates.why_relevant: Signed contracts of state bodies, public-law institutions and (since 2022) municipalities/VÚC are published in full text under §5a of Act 211/2000. Payment-service, card-acceptance, cash-transport and ATM-servicing contracts appear here with prices, volumes, unit fees and annexes — the single richest public source of hard commercial terms in the SK payments market.
candidates.legal_status: mandatory disclosure (Act 211/2000 Z. z. §5a); published contracts are public information
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-text search on Slovak keyword set (akceptácia platobných kariet, platobný terminál, bankomat, spracovanie hotovosti, prevoz cenín) + per-supplier and per-institution listing pages; download contract PDFs and extract quantities.
queries_used: centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva spracovanie hotovosti banka
centrálny register zmlúv zmluva platobné služby akceptácia kariet

candidates.source_name: Zmluvy.gov.sk – legacy/alternate CRZ front-end
candidates.why_relevant: Alternative listing interface over the Central Register of Contracts organised by institution; useful when the main CRZ search is rate-limited or when enumerating all contracts of a specific buyer (e.g. Slovenská pošta).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Institution-ID based crawling (index.php?ID=...).
queries_used: Slovenská pošta verejné obstarávanie spracovanie hotovosti zmluva bankomaty tender

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU OJ Supplement)
candidates.why_relevant: All above-EU-threshold Slovak contracting-authority notices are duplicated here in structured eForms/XML with CPV codes, values and award results. Superior to the national bulletin for machine processing and for cross-border comparison of ATM/POS/cash-handling contracts.
candidates.source_subtype: EU-level procurement gazette with API/bulk data
candidates.access_status: public; search UI plus documented API and bulk XML
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED search API queries filtered country=SVK plus CPV/keyword; fall back to bulk XML packages mirrored on data.europa.eu.
queries_used: TED tenders europa.eu Slovakia payment terminals ATM contract notice bankomaty

candidates.source_name: data.europa.eu – TED procurement notices dataset
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk, reusable XML/RDF distribution of TED notices (and mirrors of Slovak data.gov.sk datasets), enabling offline longitudinal analysis of SK payments-related procurement without hammering the live portals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Dataset API / direct package download, then local CPV filtering.
queries_used: TED tenders europa.eu Slovakia payment terminals ATM contract notice bankomaty

candidates.source_name: data.gov.sk / open.slovensko.sk – Vestník VO open data (XML)
candidates.why_relevant: ÚVO publishes the procurement bulletin daily as XML on the national open-data portal (cooperation with NASES). This is the machine-readable backbone for a repeatable collector rather than scraping HTML.
candidates.access_status: public; some historical downloads may require registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Dataset discovery via CKAN-style API, then scheduled XML download and parsing.
queries_used: uvo.gov.sk open data API vestník JSON otvorené dáta verejné obstarávanie

candidates.source_name: Elektronická platforma / IS EPVO (elektronickaplatforma.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: The state's central electronic procurement platform (successor/companion to IS EVO) where tender documentation — technical specifications listing terminal counts, ATM models, service SLAs, cash volumes — is actually hosted and downloadable.
candidates.access_status: public browsing of published tenders; participation requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Follow document links from Vestník/TED notices into the platform; download súťažné podklady PDFs.
queries_used: Josephine ERANET eZakazky elektronický systém verejného obstarávania Slovensko portál

candidates.source_name: JOSEPHINE (PROEBIZ) – electronic tendering system
candidates.why_relevant: Second-most-used SK e-procurement system (~22% share). Many banks-adjacent and municipal buyers publish full tender documentation here; the public tender list is browsable without login and links to specification documents.
candidates.access_status: public list; document download may need free registration
candidates.legal_status: private platform hosting mandatory public disclosures
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape public-tenders list with keyword filter; respect robots/ToS and throttle.
queries_used: Josephine ERANET eZakazky elektronický systém verejného obstarávania Slovensko portál

candidates.source_name: ERANET – procurement management system (incl. posta.eranet.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Hosts tenders for major cash-relevant buyers; Slovenská pošta publishes its contracts announced since 1 Aug 2021 on its ERANET instance. Postal/branch cash-handling, cash transport and Poštomat ATM-related procurements surface here.
candidates.access_status: public record pages; some documents behind registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl per-authority subdomains (posta.eranet.sk, zse.eranet.sk) publicListRecord endpoints.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Slovenská pošta procurement page
queries_used: Slovenská pošta verejné obstarávanie spracovanie hotovosti zmluva bankomaty tender

candidates.source_name: eZakazky – electronic public procurement platform
candidates.why_relevant: ~8% of SK electronic procurement runs through eZakazky; publishes tenders and enables supplier communication. Complements Josephine/ERANET for full coverage of where documentation lives.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered scraping of the public tender list.
queries_used: Josephine ERANET eZakazky elektronický systém verejného obstarávania Slovensko portál

candidates.source_name: Elektronický kontraktačný systém (EKS) / elektronické trhovisko
candidates.why_relevant: Central state marketplace for commonly available goods and services, with ~100k concluded contracts. Low-value but high-frequency purchases — POS terminal accessories, cash registers, paper rolls, coin counters, ATM consumables — are visible here with unit prices and quantities, giving granular volume signals absent from big tenders.
candidates.source_subtype: state electronic marketplace / dynamic purchasing system
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl portal.eks.sk contract detail pages (Zakazky/Detail/{id}) and index by keyword/CPV; capture quantity and unit price fields.
queries_used: Elektronický kontraktačný systém eks.sk elektronické trhovisko zákazky Slovensko

candidates.source_name: UVOstat.sk – third-party analytics over ÚVO data (with API)
candidates.why_relevant: Restructures ÚVO bulletin and contract-register data into per-authority and per-supplier profiles with aggregate values, making it far faster to answer 'who buys/sells ATM and payment services to the SK state and for how much'. Documented API exists (token required).
candidates.access_status: public web; API needs ApiToken (401 without)
candidates.legal_status: third-party reuse of open public data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Request an API token and pull supplier/authority endpoints; otherwise scrape profile pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from CRZ and NBS searches
queries_used: centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva spracovanie hotovosti banka
Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa zmluvy
candidates.observed_blocker: API documentation states all requests require an ApiToken header; without it the API returns 401 Unauthorized (web UI itself appears open).

candidates.source_name: TenderRadar.sk – multi-source SK/EU tender aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates ÚVO, EKS, CRZ, Vestník VO and TED into one searchable stream — a convenient cross-check that a payments/ATM tender was not missed in any single register, and a pointer to which registers matter.
candidates.access_status: freemium; alerts/full search likely behind account
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/monitoring use for cross-validation; do not treat as primary.
queries_used: otvorene.sk znasichdani.sk tender.sk databáza verejných obstarávaní Slovensko analýza

candidates.source_name: Tender.sk – commercial SK tender database and analytics
candidates.why_relevant: Operating since 2004 with branch-level classification; useful for categorised historical retrieval (e.g. logistics/cash services, IT/payment systems) and for spotting private-sector as well as state tenders.
candidates.legal_status: commercial; ToS likely restricts bulk extraction
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual analyst use only under subscription; do not scrape.
queries_used: otvorene.sk znasichdani.sk tender.sk databáza verejných obstarávaní Slovensko analýza
candidates.observed_blocker: Marketed as subscription platform with free trial; full records not openly accessible.

candidates.source_name: Národná banka Slovenska – verejné obstarávanie / zmluvy, objednávky, faktúry
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank's own contract, order and invoice disclosures. Highly targeted for cash-cycle intelligence: banknote processing machines, cash sorting/authentication equipment, cash logistics, coin handling — exactly the equipment side of cash usage that no statistical release itemises.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry listings plus the ÚVO profile; diff against previous snapshot.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska verejné obstarávanie profil obstarávateľa zmluvy

candidates.source_name: Slovenská pošta – verejné obstarávanie (nadlimitné zákazky)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is a state-owned operator of a large branch cash network and is closely tied to Poštová banka's Poštomat ATM network. Its tenders cover cash transport, security, branch cash handling and payment-acceptance IT, exposing counts of branches, devices and cash volumes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl posta.sk procurement pages and the linked posta.eranet.sk instance; cross-reference CRZ entries for Slovenská pošta.
queries_used: Slovenská pošta verejné obstarávanie spracovanie hotovosti zmluva bankomaty tender

candidates.source_name: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka – CRZ contract listing
candidates.why_relevant: A state-owned bank whose full contract set is published in CRZ — including IT, card/payment-service and cash-handling suppliers. Provides a rare readable view of an actual bank's vendor stack and pricing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated crawl of the institution's CRZ page; download and text-extract PDFs.
queries_used: centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva spracovanie hotovosti banka

candidates.source_name: eGovZmluvy (zmluvy.egov.sk) – municipal/school contract publishing register
candidates.why_relevant: Many municipalities, schools and contributory organisations publish contracts and orders here (with CRZ interlinking). Captures the long tail of small POS-terminal, cash-register and cash-collection purchases invisible in above-threshold registers.
candidates.source_subtype: third-party disclosure register for local government
candidates.legal_status: hosts mandatory disclosures of public bodies
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search across hosted entities; sample rather than exhaustively crawl.
queries_used: centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva spracovanie hotovosti banka

candidates.source_name: Transparency International Slovensko – Otvorené verejné obstarávanie (tender.sme.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: NGO-built institution profiles covering contracts since 2005 (>€60k) and since April 2011 all above €10k. Useful for long historical back-series and for supplier concentration analysis in payments/cash services.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Historical back-fill only; verify currency of data before relying on it (may be legacy).
queries_used: otvorene.sk znasichdani.sk tender.sk databáza verejných obstarávaní Slovensko analýza
candidates.observed_blocker: Referenced mainly via a blog article; current liveness of tender.sme.sk not established — treat as unverified.

candidates.source_name: Nadácia Zastavme korupciu – procurement watchdog analyses
candidates.why_relevant: Watchdog investigations dissect specific SK tenders (e.g. a ~€4m Slovenská pošta security tender) and expose technical specifications, incumbent suppliers and vendor lock-in — narrative context and hard detail that raw registers do not surface.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword monitoring for banking/cash/payment tenders; cite, do not bulk-copy.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Slovenská pošta tender coverage
queries_used: Slovenská pošta verejné obstarávanie spracovanie hotovosti zmluva bankomaty tender

candidates.source_name: FinStat.sk – supplier/company financials cross-reference
candidates.why_relevant: Links winning suppliers of payment/ATM/cash contracts to their revenues, ownership and public-contract totals, converting a list of awards into a supplier market-share view of the SK payments services market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Lookup by IČO for suppliers identified in CRZ/ÚVO awards; manual or light API/subscription use.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania platobné terminály bankomaty
candidates.observed_blocker: Detailed financial data requires a paid FinStat account; basic company pages are open.

candidates.source_name: Obchodný vestník (Commercial Bulletin, justice.gov.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory commercial gazette carrying corporate, insolvency, auction and some procurement-adjacent notices for SK entities; useful for tracking the corporate lifecycle of payment/ATM service suppliers identified from contract awards.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted searches by supplier name/IČO rather than bulk crawling.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ÚVO seed query results
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania platobné terminály bankomaty

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo obrany SR – verejné obstarávanie (example ministry buyer profile)
candidates.why_relevant: Illustrates the standard per-ministry procurement page pattern in SK. Every ministry, Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa and Štátna pokladnica maintains an equivalent page — collectively the enumerable set of public buyers of card-acceptance and cash services.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a template to derive the equivalent URL pattern for each *.gov.sk buyer; prefer the ÚVO profile as canonical.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania platobné terminály bankomaty

candidates.source_name: Finančná správa SR – published documents and procurement (eKasa / cashless acceptance mandate)
candidates.why_relevant: The tax authority publishes methodological guidance and legislative documents on eKasa and, under Act 384/2025, the obligation from 1 March 2026 for sellers to enable cashless payment above €1 — a regulatory driver of POS terminal demand. Its own procurement (eKasa infrastructure) is a further quantitative source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the Zverejňovanie dokumentov / Tlačové správy sections plus its ÚVO profile; extract eKasa device counts where published.
queries_used: Finančná správa SR verejné obstarávanie eKasa pokladnice platobné terminály zmluva

negative_findings.description: General web search could not surface individual SK procurement notices or contracts specifically for payment terminals / ATMs — neither via Slovak terms (platobné terminály, bankomaty) nor English (payment terminals, ATM contract notice Slovakia).
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines returned only portal homepages and generic explainers; ÚVO, CRZ and TED notice pages appear to be poorly indexed or only reachable through their own internal search forms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell cannot rely on web search. It must go through each register's own query interface, CPV-code filtering, or the bulk XML/API distributions.

negative_findings.description: UVOstat.sk offers a documented API but every request requires an ApiToken header.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documentation (GitHub MiroBabic/uvostat_api) states requests without a valid token return 401 Unauthorized.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most convenient aggregated view of SK procurement is not immediately machine-accessible; a token request or fallback to raw ÚVO/CRZ scraping is needed.

negative_findings.description: tender.sme.sk (Transparency International Slovensko's open-procurement site) was referenced only indirectly through a 2011-era blog post; no current page was observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: No direct confirmation of the site's current state; it may be archived or merged into another TIS product.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical back-series before ~2014 may need to come from web archives rather than a live service.

negative_findings.description: No public procurement or contract-register evidence was found for commercial bank ATM/POS purchases (Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB), as these are private entities outside disclosure obligations.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only state-owned or public-law banking entities (NBS, SZRB, Slovenská pošta / Poštová banka linkage) surface in the registers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The procurement channel structurally covers only the public-sector share of the SK payments/ATM market; commercial bank fleet data must come from other workstreams.

negative_findings.description: Reporting on the ÚVO open-data XML feed on data.gov.sk/open.slovensko.sk referenced coverage starting with 2014-2015 and gradual backfill; the current completeness and endpoint stability were not confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: NASES announcement and a slovensko.digital thread describe the dataset, but no current dataset landing page was directly inspected.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector built on the bulk XML may silently miss recent years or newer eForms formats; endpoint must be validated before relying on it.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list has yet been fixed for the payments/ATM/cash domain in SK procurement (candidates include 30123400 sorting/counting machines, 30233190 card readers, 66110000 banking services, 79710000 security/cash-in-transit services, 48000000 software).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and validate a CPV whitelist by sampling known contracts in CRZ/ÚVO, then use it as the primary machine filter across ÚVO, TED and EKS.

coverage_gaps.description: Key public buyers of card-acceptance and cash services were not individually verified: Sociálna poisťovňa, Štátna pokladnica, Ministerstvo financií SR, Železnice/ZSSK, Bratislava/Košice transport operators, university hospitals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate their ÚVO profiles and CRZ institution pages and add each as its own candidate source in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The concrete TED API endpoint and query syntax for country=SVK plus CPV filtering was not confirmed in this pass; only the TED portal and general dataset references were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and document the current TED search API version and its rate limits before building the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: The supplier side (cash-in-transit and ATM service firms operating in SK — e.g. security/CIT companies, ATM deployers) was not mapped from award records in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract winner names from ÚVO/CRZ award notices, then profile each via FinStat and Obchodný vestník to build a supplier concentration map.

coverage_gaps.description: Below-threshold and small municipal purchases of POS terminals and cash-handling equipment are dispersed across EKS, eGovZmluvy and hundreds of municipal sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat EKS as the primary sub-threshold instrument and sample eGovZmluvy rather than attempting exhaustive municipal coverage.

brief: Slovakia's procurement disclosure stack is unusually rich for this cell: ÚVO's Vestník verejného obstarávania (with an XML open-data feed and profile registry) covers notices, the Centrálny register zmlúv publishes full signed contracts of state bodies and municipalities under Act 211/2000, and the EKS electronic marketplace captures the high-frequency sub-threshold purchases where terminal, cash-register and cash-handling quantities are itemised; TED duplicates all above-threshold SK notices in structured, machine-readable form. The highest-value single actors are NBS (its own zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry disclosures on cash-cycle equipment), Slovenská pošta via its ERANET instance, and state-owned SZRB whose full contract set is readable in CRZ. Aggregators (UVOstat, TenderRadar, tender.sk, FinStat) accelerate supplier-concentration analysis but are variously token-gated or paywalled and should not be primary. The binding constraint is not access but filtering: web search does not index individual notices, so collection must be driven by a validated CPV whitelist plus Slovak keyword sets (platobný terminál, bankomat, akceptácia platobných kariet, spracovanie/prevoz hotovosti) applied inside each register's own interface or bulk feed.
